_help: Subtitle colour class -> Kokoro voice. Classes come from the OCR'd text colour: yellow (dialogue), cyan (narrator), white (OP/ED song lyrics), red, green, other. Use "skip" to not voice a class. Language is inferred from the voice prefix (a*=en-us, b*=en-gb). Voices: af_heart af_bella af_nicole af_sarah am_michael am_fenrir am_puck am_onyx bf_emma bf_isabella bm_george bm_fable bm_lewis bm_daniel ... Override on the command line with --voice cyan=bm_lewis.
